packs.name: Organized Crime Ring
packs.description: Money laundering, front businesses and syndicate politics. Requires the White Collar Fraud pack (which in turn requires White Collar Jobs) — this pack demonstrates transitive pack dependencies.

packs.name: White Collar Fraud
packs.description: Ledger crime: embezzlement, insider trading and cooked books — gated on holding a white_collar job from the White Collar Jobs pack. Raise too much heat and the auditors come.

packs.name: White Collar Jobs
packs.description: A corporate career track: mailroom to analyst to senior roles. Jobs here use the "white_collar" field, which crime and career packs gate on with {kind:"job", field:"white_collar"} conditions.
